title: FDN mirrors · DraftZero Exp1 fair
summary: Three public DraftZero Exp1 checkpoints, gen0/gen10/gen33, with released final-evaluation search settings and random/heuristic anchors on sixteen public Foundations draft decks. Full round robin with four seat-swapped pairs per deck and matchup. Permitted reconstruction and disabled opponent-hand encoding change the learned policies; CPU float32 inference differs from the released float16 run. Every bot uses the same clock. The live validator checks every decision; halted and truncated games are unrated and their rates are shown.

display.label: random
display.author: Spellbench
display.description: Picks uniformly at random among the offered actions. The anchor: its Elo is fixed at 1000.

display.label: heuristic
display.author: Spellbench
display.description: Fixed priorities: play a land, cast a spell, activate an ability; attacks with everything and never blocks.

display.label: DraftZero Exp1 gen0 fair
display.author: DraftZero / Spellbench
display.description: Released generation-zero initialization control. Public Exp1 gen0 checkpoint with released final-evaluation 96-visit/12-second search settings. Permitted reconstructed worlds, own-visible replay and opponent-hand encoding disabled; confined CPU float32 inference differs from the released float16 run. This is a changed fair variant, not the original privileged evaluation.
